bundle.shortDescription: Point at the UI. Reach the source.
bundle.longDescription: RootRay is a lightweight, local-first Windows developer tool for React/Vite projects. Point at a rendered element to reach its source, inspect component and style relationships, navigate the project, and make safe quick edits.
